title: Foulkes' conjecture for sixth powers and quadratic stabilization

result.label: Foulkes' conjecture for sixth powers and quadratic stabilization
result.statement: Proves the sixth case of Foulkes’ conjecture: Sym ^6( Sym ^bV) embeds equivariantly in Sym ^b( Sym ^6V) for every b ≥ 6 and finite-dimensional complex V . More generally, the canonical multiplication map Sym ^b( Sym ^aV) Sym ^a( Sym ^bV) is surjective for a ≥ 2 and b a(a-1), giving dimension-independent quadratic stabilization.
